name: Harvest
one_liner: Time-tracking app whose V2 REST API covers time, expenses and projects.
auth_notes: Requests are authenticated with OAuth2 or Personal Access Tokens sent as a Bearer token, plus a Harvest-Account-Id header and a required User-Agent header.
access_notes: Cached pages cover only the V2 overview. They do not say how tokens are obtained, which plans include API access, or cost.

buildability.rationale: The V2 REST API and its auth options are documented. Credential access, plan gating and endpoint breadth are not in the cached pages, so buildability cannot be confirmed.

identity.quote: The Harvest V2 API is a REST API that allows you to interact with your Harvest account programmatically.

auth.quote: Harvest requires applications to authenticate all requests with OAuth2 or Personal Access Tokens.

api_surface.quote: The rate limit for general API requests is 100 requests per 15 seconds.

needs_human_reason: Only the V2 overview page was cached. Access tier, token creation, sandbox and MCP status are unverified. The app is getharvest.com time tracking, not Greenhouse Harvest.
